english.title: Fail to produce document / record / equine ID when required by person enforcing the Regulations
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to produce

(A)_[a document,]_
(B)_[a record,]_
(C)_[an ID,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENT, RECORD OR ID..), when required to do so to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person acting in the course of enforcing the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019 or Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2015/262
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 28(c) and 34 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019.

Summary: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 monthsNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
